name: WhatsAstra
description:
WhatsAstra brings WhatsApp to astraOS as a native app, built from the system's own components: it follows your light or dark mode, your text size and the system's gestures.

Open it, sign in with your AstraID, then on your main phone go to WhatsApp > Settings > Linked devices > Link a device and scan the code. Your chats and new messages arrive as notifications.

WhatsApp's protocol runs on your astraOS server (OpenWA). WhatsApp does not support other apps officially: a linked account can be restricted by WhatsApp.

WhatsAstra is not made by or affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.
notes: A native astraOS app: no more web page. Chats, conversations and notifications through your astraOS server.

story.title: Your chats, now on astraOS
story.subtitle: WhatsAstra links to WhatsApp in seconds
story.body: Scan one QR code from your main phone and every chat is here: voice notes, photos, groups and notifications.
